query: Document the acid release at bund B-7 and file the compliance report.
scene:
SITE: Port Kembla chemical terminal, containment bund B-7.
EVENT: approximately 200 L of dilute sulphuric acid released from a transfer hose failure at 13:55.
HAZARDS: low pH release, stormwater pathway to the harbour, licence exceedance with a 24 h statutory notification window.
You are the HSE compliance agent. The record you build is the evidence the regulator will use to set fines, licence conditions and liability.

steps.label: pH sensor calibrated
steps.result: PH-12 calibrated 2026-07-28, cert on file.

steps.label: Plug the stormwater drain
steps.result: Stormwater drain SD-3 plugged, isolation confirmed.

steps.label: Check bund capacity
steps.result: Bund B-7 rated 12 kL, release well within containment volume.

steps.label: Read past spill history
steps.result: One prior reportable release in 2023, different bund.

steps.label: Check the drainage plan
steps.result: Stormwater plan confirms SD-3 is the only pathway to the harbour.

steps.label: Notify the supervisor
steps.result: Site supervisor notified at 14:02, response team mobilised.

steps.label: Photograph the scene
steps.result: 14 time-stamped photographs captured of the bund and outlet.

steps.label: Take sample at the drain
steps.result: Sample S-103 taken upstream of the plugged drain, sealed.

steps.label: Record the forecast
steps.result: No rain forecast for 12 h, low remobilisation risk.

steps.label: Apply absorbent
steps.result: Acid-neutralising absorbent applied to the bund floor.

steps.label: Check soda ash stock
steps.result: 480 kg soda ash on site, sufficient for the estimated volume.

steps.label: Read the acid safety sheet
steps.result: H2SO4 MSDS reviewed: corrosive, exothermic on dilution.

steps.label: Interview the operator
steps.result: Operator OP-77 statement recorded: hose failed during transfer at 13:55.

steps.label: Read pH in the bund
steps.result: pH = 3.4. Licence condition requires 6.0-9.0 at the discharge point. OVER LIMIT - reportable exceedance.

steps.label: Deploy absorbent boom
steps.result: Absorbent boom deployed across the bund outlet.

steps.label: Estimate how much spilled
steps.result: Release estimated at 205 L from transfer-hose failure at 13:55.

steps.label: Find the leak source
steps.result: Source traced to transfer hose TH-4, longitudinal split near the coupling.

steps.label: Check the tide
steps.result: Outgoing tide, would have accelerated dispersion if released.

steps.label: Shut off the leak
steps.result: TH-4 isolated at the manifold, transfer pump stopped, line depressurised.

steps.label: Record the weather
steps.result: 17 C, light NE wind 8 km/h, no rain in the preceding 6 h.

steps.label: Carbon sensor calibrated
steps.result: TOC-2 calibrated 2026-07-21, cert on file.

steps.label: Photograph the plugged drain
steps.result: Plugged drain SD-3 photographed with time stamp.

steps.label: Read carbon at the outfall
steps.result: TOC 41 mg/L against a 30 mg/L limit.

steps.label: Look up licence conditions
steps.result: EPL-3312: pH 6.0-9.0, TOC <30 mg/L at the licensed discharge point.

steps.label: Team in protective gear
steps.result: Response team in acid-resistant suits and face shields.

steps.label: Conductivity sensor calibrated
steps.result: EC-4 calibrated 2026-07-28, cert on file.

steps.label: Read conductivity
steps.result: Conductivity 4820 uS/cm, elevated.

steps.label: Take sample in the bund
steps.result: Sample S-101 taken at -34.4821, 150.8309, chain-of-custody opened.

race.label: Compare pH to the licence limit

steps.label: Compare pH to the licence limit
steps.result: pH 3.4 vs licence 6.0-9.0 -> EXCEEDANCE confirmed, notification clock started.

race.label: Compare pH to the licence limit

steps.label: Seal sample 101
steps.result: Custody unbroken, two signatures.

steps.label: Take sample at the outfall
steps.result: Sample S-102 taken at the licensed discharge point, sealed.

steps.label: Seal sample 102
steps.result: Custody unbroken, two signatures.

steps.label: Compare carbon to the limit
steps.result: TOC 41 vs 30 mg/L -> exceedance confirmed.

steps.label: Record soil removed
steps.result: Contaminated bund sediment drummed for disposal.

steps.label: Record neutralising
steps.result: Soda ash dosed, pH rising through 5.2 at 14:40.

steps.label: Record liquid recovered
steps.result: 184 L recovered to the waste tank.

steps.label: Attach custody forms
steps.result: Chain-of-custody forms attached.

steps.label: Attach lab results
steps.result: Laboratory results attached.

steps.label: Attach photographs
steps.result: Time-stamped site photographs attached.

steps.label: Notify the regulator
steps.result: Statutory notification lodged, reference EPA-2026-11884.

steps.label: Compile the report
steps.result: Draft incident report assembled.

steps.label: File the report
steps.result: REPORT SPILL-B7 FILED with the regulator. Record closed.
